name: Sparkworks Enhanced
description: Adds the category "Sparkworks Enhanced" to the Sparkworks editor with five logic nodes: "Environment" is on at night, during the day, in a chosen time span, or while it rains, snows or is clear where the graph's objects are; "Random" rolls a chance whenever a signal comes in; "Random Timer" passes a signal on after a random delay (switching on and off, only on, or for a fixed time) or switches on and off at random intervals; "Counter" counts signals and passes one on from a chosen count until its reset input gets a signal; "Alert" shows a center-screen message (door opened, alarm raised, alarm resolved) or plays one of 28 game sounds at the objects after it. Trigger areas named like "Entrance (2)" need at least that many inside, "(=2)" exactly, "(<2)" at least one but fewer, "(>2)" more; "(@Name)" counts only those players, "(!Name)" everyone except them; "(NPC)" only villagers, "(!NPC)" only players; "(Chest 80%)" switches on while the chests in the area (or the chest right under it) are at least 80% full (also "<", ">", "="), "(Chest open)" for a moment when one is opened (German: Kiste, offen). English and German. Native DLL, loaded by the dinput8.dll loader.
